note: Every figure was read on a page fetched on 2026-11-28. The table is Wikipedia's 2026-27 Premier League table as of 27 November 2026 (Chelsea 12 played, most others 11). Only the Leeds (21 Nov) and Forest (27 Nov) results are used as match results. NOT used: goal minutes (ESPN, RTE and Complete Sports disagree on them); any quote from Alonso (ESPN's summary and RTE disagree on whether he was quoted); Chelsea's earlier results (the ESPN results table has a home/away and score orientation that disagrees with Wikipedia on Brentford and Bournemouth, so none of those are used); the identity of the first of the three defeats (no fetched page names it); 'four defeats in five' (one page only); Leeds' first win at Stamford Bridge since 1999, boos, and 'third defeat in four games' (search snippets only, not on any fetched page). Venue is used only for the Leeds game (Stamford Bridge). The fees come from Wikipedia's Chelsea season page as extracted by a page summariser. The video does not predict a result or say whether the manager will stay.
